name: Install Claude Code
description: Anthropic's official native installer for macOS, Linux and WSL, then print the version to confirm.
author: voltius

snippets.name: Install Claude Code
snippets.description: Installs to ~/.local/bin and self-updates in the background.

steps.content:
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash

# The installer adds ~/.local/bin to PATH in your shell profile; this session
# may not have picked it up yet.
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
claude --version
